on_surplus.note: Profits are removed from the risk sleeve and never re-risked at larger size.

on_deficit.note: Losses reload slowly and capped. Revenge sizing is structurally unavailable.
on_deficit.annual_cap_rationale: The weekly cap limits the RATE of bleed but not the TOTAL. Without an annual budget, 2%/week for 52 weeks could drain Core entirely.

charter_resize.note: Bet size follows banked equity only. Never unrealized PnL, never conviction.

compression_break.thesis: Volatility mean-reverts and clusters; buy cheap optionality ahead of a statistically due expansion. Direction is read off the break, never forecast.

post_earnings_drift.thesis: A held earnings gap drifts for weeks as institutions reposition. Enter AFTER the IV crush, never before.

structure.rationale: Short leg cuts debit 35-45%, converting a 1-position sleeve into a 3-position sleeve and capping theta bleed.

exits.note: Target is stated in units of DEBIT PAID, not percent of max profit. The two differ and mixing them corrupts all downstream expectancy math.

universe_filters.strike_grid_rule: trade the liquid strike grid for the chain ($5 on SPY), never the $1 grid
universe_filters.width_rule: width is FREE (max loss on a debit vertical = debit paid, not width); choose width so the debit lands just under the $150 cap
universe_filters.corrected_in_v1_1: v1.0 required $1-strike ETFs on the false premise that a $5 width forces $500 max risk. That is a CREDIT-spread number. The old rule also steered into the illiquid grid.

cadence.open_avoidance_rationale: First 15 minutes carry the widest spreads of the day (friction constraint C4).

pre_trade_checklist: setup conditions fully met (no partial credit)
spread bid/ask <= 10% of mid right now
not in LOCKDOWN; >= 2 day trades available
no earnings before exit date (CB only)
GTC target and stop ready to place on fill
checklist_rule: Any unchecked box is a NO TRADE. Not a smaller trade -- a no trade.

falsification.correct_action_on_falsification: stop trading convexity and hold core; do NOT tune parameters until the backtest looks better

impossible_goal_note.compounded_1yr: 2^252 = 7.2e75, exceeds all world financial assets (~1e15) by ~60 orders of magnitude
impossible_goal_note.blocked_by: PDT rule caps this account at 3 day trades per 5 business days; daily doubling needs ~5/week

disclaimer: Not financial advice. Specification only. No trades placed. All expectancy figures are illustrative calculations from assumed hit rates, not backtested results.

simulation.key_finding: A full-size daily bet with a FLAT arithmetic edge still ruins 100% of the time, because volatility drag makes its geometric return -21%/trade. Sizing, not skill, is what defeats this.
simulation.caveat: Assumptions, not backtests. No historical validation of CB or PED filters was performed.

execution.rationale: Strike choice moves break-even hit rate 13 points; order type moves it nearly as much. Execution IS the strategy at $1,500.
execution.walk_rule_correction_v1_2: v1.1 said 'walk at most $0.02'. Single-name chains tick in $0.05 above $3.00, so $0.02 is unexpressible. Corrected to one tick.

spy_only_module.setup_b_replaced: PED cannot fire on SPY (no earnings); replaced by Trend Pullback (TPB)

trend_pullback.trigger: first daily close above prior session high
trend_pullback.event_filter: not within 2 sessions of FOMC, CPI, or NFP

correlation_cost_rho_0_85_vs_0.reading: Correlation does not cost expected return; it widens the distribution both ways. Survivable only because the sleeve is capped at 30%.

spy_only_module.whole_account_is_one_asset: Core is SPY and Convexity is SPY, so there is no diversification anywhere in this account. Explicit accepted tradeoff.

bb_width_1y_context.reading: current 2.21% is at or near the 1-year minimum

live_state_2026_09_02.compression_break: ARMED, NOT TRIGGERED — needs a daily close above 773.52 or below 756.58
live_state_2026_09_02.trend_pullback: regime + washout PASS; trigger pending today close
live_state_2026_09_02.caution: The two setups firing together are not independent confirmations — both read the same quiet tape. Size as ONE position.

high_beta_module.key_finding: Delta-matched 30-delta verticals have ~21-22% probability of profit across IV from 10.7% (SPY) to 71.4% (MSTR). Higher IV does NOT improve win odds — it is already in the price. What improves is reward:risk and the target as a fraction of max profit.
high_beta_module.cost: Single names tick in $0.05 vs SPY pennies. Break-even hit rate rises from 34.3% to ~38.6-39.4% on a patient one-tick fill, and to 47-64% if you cross the spread.

TSLA.reason: ask size 2 / bid size 3 — book too thin to exit under stress

structural_changes.setup_b_revived: Post-Earnings Drift can fire again on single names; it never could on SPY. Restores a second uncorrelated return driver.
structural_changes.earnings_now_binding: Every single-name entry MUST verify the earnings date falls after the planned exit. Pre-trade check, not monitoring.
structural_changes.correlation: SPY and NVDA are partially correlated — the max-2-same-direction cap applies across the pair, not to each separately.
structural_changes.gap_risk: Single names gap harder than an index. The -50% stop is a resting order, not a guarantee.

high_beta_module.frequency_unchanged: Still max 2 entries/week. Frequency multiplies friction; volatility does not.
